_readme: Monthly API budget for the AI newsroom (owner order 2026-09-01: never go
over budget again). budget_ledger.py records every desk's estimated spend
in originals/_ledger.json and paces the discretionary desks against their
allocation — a desk ahead of its linear monthly pace skips runs until the
pace catches up, instead of the whole paper hitting the provider cap and
freezing like August. The briefs desk (the wire) is never paced; it stops
only at hard_stop_fraction of the budget, keeping last-resort headroom
under the real cap. Estimates run 10% hot at list price on purpose.
THE OWNER'S KNOB is monthly_budget_usd — set it at or slightly below the
org's actual Anthropic monthly limit. Allocations are fractions of the
budget; they may sum to less than 1 (the remainder is reserve headroom).
